notes.title: Demo out now!
notes.content:
Rhythm game enthusiasts, the wait is over! The anticipated Sonic Surge: Rhythm Showdown has just dropped its demo, giving players a first taste of the electrifying action and pulse-pounding beats.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45333396/29f76992deb202cdd42c2dca9266d2cf6caa20f2.jpg[/img]

The demo features four adrenaline-pumping tracks designed to test your rhythm skills and immerse you in the dynamic world of Sonic Surge. Each song offers unique challenges, ensuring players of all skill levels have something to enjoy while pushing their abilities to the limit.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45333396/48f2426f42002a6c68b8898acc89c9b2f25a6354.jpg[/img]

The demo release marks the first step in the journey to deliver the ultimate rhythm showdown experience. Feedback is welcome, as it will help shape the final game for fans worldwide.

Download the Sonic Surge: Rhythm Showdown demo now and see if you have what it takes to ride the rhythm!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3428130/Sonic_Surge__Rhythm_Showdown_Demo/]Download the Demo[/url]

Stay tuned for more updates, additional tracks, and exciting features coming soon!
